newsitem.title: USA: Indiana wheat rated 70 pct good to excellent.
newsitem.headline: Indiana wheat rated 70 pct good to excellent.

text.p: Indiana's winter wheat was rated 15 percent excellent and 55 percent good during the week ended Sunday, according to Indiana's Agricultural Statistics Service.
The wheat was rated 24 percent fair and six percent poor. Two percent of the crop had jointed versus one a year ago and the four percent average.
"The wheat has plenty of moisture and is now awaiting warmer weather to progress," the report said.
Hay supplies were rated two percent surplus, 43 adequate, 46 short and nine very short.
Pastures were rated four percent excellent, 33 good, 46 fair, 12 poor and five very poor.
"Some farmers were moving cattle to pasture sooner than they would like to because of the high price and short supply of hay," the report said.
Topsoil moisture was rated 38 percent surplus and 62 adequate. Subsoil moisture was rated 39 percent surplus and 61 adequate.
